app_commit: the uncommitted tree that became this repository's first commit
gateway: isolated temporary home, approval=reads; a freshly seeded gateway for the stub screenshots, one for the live ones and one for the walkthrough
data: fictional, seeded through the app's HTTP API (capture/scenes.json)

agent_backend.stub: Kiro Crew's offline stub ACP backend (capture/stub_backend.py) for every other scene; no chat reply is shown from it
agent_backend.credit_reading: the browser answers the top bar's credit readout (/api/sessions/usage) with "no reading", so no account balance or email can be shown

note: The isolated gateway served this repository's own copy of the app: capture.py's setup installed it from this checkout (POST /api/apps/install), trusted it and enabled it, and every picture shows its committed bundle (ui/dist/index.mjs), its backend and its in-gateway routes. Kiro Crew still ships a built-in dev-fleet and refuses a second install under the same name, so the Kiro Crew tree the capture ran on is the port commit with only the built-in copy removed (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/dev_fleet and its BUILTIN_NAMES row); kirocrew_tree_dirty records that. KIROCREW_PROJECT_DIR named the fictional checkout, and HOME was a throwaway directory so no pod state of the capture host shows.
data_notes: The checkout the page manages is fictional: capture/make_fixture.py builds a small git repository with the Kiro Crew checkout markers and four feature worktrees with made-up branch names and an example.invalid author, under the system temp directory. It has no remote and no GitHub pull requests, so no pull-request state is shown and Prune merged keeps every worktree: it removes only work it can prove shipped.

Each gateway waits 50 seconds after the app is turned on, before any picture and before the recording starts: the backend starts before the gateway has registered the app's in-gateway routes, so its first read of the live-target state fails and the page says the live state is unavailable until the next read, up to about 40 seconds later (PORTING.md, gap 10).
Pods are not provisioned on the capture host, so every feature row offers Provision and no pod runs; the README says what a provisioned pod adds.
